issues.t: Door lock actuators stop working
issues.sym: One or more doors will not lock or unlock with the remote or switch.
issues.why: The motor inside the door lock actuator wears out. Owners call it the most common complaint on this generation.
issues.next: Replace the actuator, or just its motor if you are handy.

issues.t: Front bushings and lower ball joints wear out
issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, vibration, wandering, or the car will not hold an alignment.
issues.why: Rubber bushings in the control arms, sway bar and steering parts wear out, and the lower ball joints have a high failure rate. Lexus issued a ball joint inspection bulletin.
issues.next: Have the front suspension checked, especially the ball joints. A ball joint that separates can cause loss of control.

issues.t: Fuel pump fails at high mileage
issues.sym: Long cranking, sputtering, or the engine will not start.
issues.why: Owners report in-tank fuel pump failures on high-mileage cars.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure tested before replacing parts.

issues.t: Steering wheel vibration or flutter
issues.sym: A shake or flutter felt through the steering wheel at certain speeds.
issues.why: Lexus made production changes for steering vibration and flutter on early cars and issued bulletin ST00398.
issues.next: Have the wheels balanced and tires checked first, then ask about the bulletin.

issues.t: Moonroof creaks or motor stops working
issues.sym: Creaking or popping from the moonroof area, or the moonroof will not open or close.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletins for moonroof creaks and for the moonroof motor on certain VIN ranges.
issues.next: Have the moonroof tracks cleaned and checked, and the motor tested if it will not move.

issues.t: Rattles from the glove box and dash
issues.sym: Rattling or squeaks from the glove box, dash panels or rear seat belt area.
issues.why: Lexus issued several bulletins for rattles around the glove box, instrument panel and seat belt retractors.
issues.next: A shop can add felt tape or replace clips per the bulletins.

issues.t: Climate display blank at startup
issues.sym: The A/C temperature display is blank when you start the car, or the A/C indicator does not work right.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin AC00101 for this on navigation-equipped cars, plus earlier A/C malfunction bulletins.
issues.next: Ask a shop to check the climate control unit against the bulletin.

issues.t: Brake actuator failure turns on warning lights
issues.sym: Brake, ABS and traction lights come on, or a Check VSC message appears.
issues.why: The brake actuator assembly can fail inside. Lexus issued a bulletin and a warranty enhancement for this part.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Have the codes read and ask a dealer whether the brake actuator coverage still applies.

issues.t: Valve springs may break (recall)
issues.sym: Odd engine noise, rough idle, vibration or poor running. In rare cases the engine can stop while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs were contaminated during manufacturing. Covered by recall 10V-309.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the springs replaced free.

issues.t: Variable valve timing gear bolts can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Abnormal engine noise after a cold start, and possible stalling while driving.
issues.why: Bolts in the variable valve timing gear can loosen on the GS 350. Covered by recall 13V-395.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer replace the part free.

issues.t: Brief rattle on cold start
issues.sym: A short rattle or knock for a second or two right after a cold start.
issues.why: Owners commonly report this start-up noise on the GS 350 engine.
issues.next: If it lasts only a moment it is usually not urgent, but have it checked and make sure the valve timing recall was done.

issues.t: Fuel damper can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell around the car.
issues.why: Rubber in the fuel pulsation damper can harden and crack. Covered by recall 18V-432.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the fuel delivery pipe replaced free.

issues.t: Fuel rails can corrode and leak (recall)
issues.sym: The check engine light, and possibly a fuel smell.
issues.why: Aluminum fuel rails can corrode from some ethanol fuels. Covered by recall 09V-020.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the rails inspected and replaced free.

issues.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pressure sensor (recalls)
issues.sym: A fuel smell around the engine.
issues.why: The fuel pressure sensor may be loose or its seal area may leak. Covered by recalls 11V-029 and 14V-647.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer reseal the sensor free.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels different and the fluid level drops with no leak visible.
issues.why: The master cylinder seal can dry out and curl, letting fluid seep into the booster. Covered by recall 10V-499.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN and have the redesigned seal installed free.

issues.t: AWD carpet pad can catch the gas pedal (recall)
issues.sym: The gas pedal sticks partly down or returns slowly.
issues.why: A plastic pad in the floor carpet of AWD models can interfere with the pedal. Covered by recall 11V-115.
issues.next: Remove extra floor mats and have the free fix done.

issues.t: Steering feels notchy or will not center
issues.sym: The steering feels notchy or does not return smoothly to center on the highway.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletins with a repair procedure for this steering feel.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletins L-SB-0015-11 and L-SB-0016-11.

issues.t: Whine around 60 mph
issues.sym: A whining noise around 60 mph.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0012-11 for 2007-2010 GS models with a repair procedure.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the driveline against the bulletin.

issues.t: Rear brake slide pins bind and make noise
issues.sym: Noise from the rear brakes, or rear pads wearing unevenly.
issues.why: Rust can make the rear caliper slide pins bind. Lexus issued a service bulletin covering rust removal and inspection.
issues.next: Have the rear calipers serviced at your next brake job.

issues.t: Inside rearview mirror becomes discolored
issues.sym: The inside mirror turns cloudy, discolored or distorted and is hard to see through.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0043-16 with a mirror service kit for 2006-2009 GS models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about the bulletin and mirror replacement.

issues.t: Check engine light for coolant temperature
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0128 and other codes.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin LSB-0004-10 for the 2GR-FSE and 4GR-FSE V6 engines.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the thermostat checked.

issues.t: Hybrid battery warning or weak battery
issues.sym: A warning light with a hybrid battery code, reduced mileage, or the engine running more often.
issues.why: The hybrid battery can deteriorate, and dust buildup in its cooling fan makes it run hot. Lexus has bulletins on both.
issues.next: Have the hybrid system scanned and the battery fan and filter cleaned.

issues.t: Steering wheel may be left off-center (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel is crooked after restarting the car.
issues.why: Variable gear ratio steering software can leave the wheel off-center. Covered by recall 12V-221.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free software update.

issues.t: Brakes may apply on their own (recall)
issues.sym: The car brakes without you pressing the pedal, and brake warnings may show.
issues.why: The brake pedal load sensing switch can fail. Covered by recall 14V-270.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the switch replaced free.

issues.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, the check engine light, or a stall or no-start. Lean or low fuel pressure codes may be stored.
issues.why: The in-tank fuel pump can fail. Recalls 20V-012 and 20V-682 cover certain GS 350, GS 200t and GS 300 years.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the pump replaced free.

issues.t: Fuel pump failure on later GS models (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running or stalling.
issues.why: Another group of GS fuel pumps can fail and stop the engine. Covered by recall 26V-222.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the fuel pump assembly replaced free.

issues.t: GS F high-pressure fuel pump can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell and the check engine light.
issues.why: A damaged part can crack the high-pressure fuel pump cover. Covered by recall 18V-107.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the pumps replaced free.

issues.t: Front brakes squeak at low speed
issues.sym: Squeaking or squealing from the front brakes at slow speeds or after sitting overnight.
issues.why: Lexus issued several bulletins with new pads, rotors and shims for front brake noise.
issues.next: Ask the dealer which brake noise bulletin applies to your car.

issues.t: Clicking from the front wheels in slow turns
issues.sym: A clicking sound from the front when turning slowly, such as in parking lots, on rear-drive models.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletins L-SB-0011-16 and LSB001522 with repairs.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check against the bulletins.

issues.t: AWD transfer case whine
issues.sym: A whine from under the car at 30-50 mph with light throttle on AWD models.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0001-16 for 2013-2015 AWD GS 350s.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to inspect the transfer case.

issues.t: Uneven or wrong air temperature from the vents
issues.sym: Air comes out too hot or too cold, airflow is weak, or the mode will not change.
issues.why: An A/C servo motor can have an internal fault. Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0001-21 and a coverage program.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether the A/C servo coverage applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Battery drains for no clear reason
issues.sym: The battery goes dead after sitting, even with nothing left on.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0035-16 for intermittent battery drain on 2013-2015 models.
issues.next: Have the battery tested and ask the dealer about the bulletin.
